reference_dir.title: Genome
reference_dir.description: Reference genome used for alignment of RNAseq and ATACseq data

schema.title: Samplesheet
schema.description: One row per lane of each library: gex for gene expression, or atac for chromatin accessibility. ATAC libraries have three reads, so their rows also need FASTQ (R3); R2 is the barcode read. Rows with the same sample name are analyzed together in one Cell Ranger ARC run, and each sample needs both gex and atac rows. FASTQ files need Illumina names with a lane, such as PBMC_ATAC_S1_L001_R1_001.fastq.gz.

sample.title: Sample
sample.errorMessage: Sample names can only contain letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores

fastq_1.title: FASTQ (R1)
fastq_1.errorMessage: Must be an R1 FASTQ with an Illumina name, such as PBMC_ATAC_S1_L001_R1_001.fastq.gz

fastq_2.title: FASTQ (R2)
fastq_2.errorMessage: Must be an R2 FASTQ with an Illumina name, such as PBMC_ATAC_S1_L001_R2_001.fastq.gz

fastq_3.title: FASTQ (R3, ATAC only)
fastq_3.errorMessage: Must be an R3 FASTQ with an Illumina name, such as PBMC_ATAC_S1_L001_R3_001.fastq.gz
